title: A note on outlier eigenvectors for sparse non-Hermitian perturbations
summary: We consider a sparse i.i.d.\ non-Hermitian random matrix model $X_n$ (with sparsity parameter $K_n$) and a deterministic finite-rank perturbation $E_n$. Assuming biorthogonality for $E_n$ and a growth condition on $K_n$, we outline a finite-rank resolvent reduction leading to asymptotics for the overlap between an outlier eigenvector of $Y_n:=X_n+E_n$ and the corresponding spike eigenspace. In particular, for an outlier spike $μ$ with $|μ|>1$, the squared projection of the associated (right) eigenvector onto the spike eigenspace converges in probability to $1-|μ|^{-2}$. Our result…
